verdict.rationale: Aider has a programmatic surface, a Python scripting interface, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no such reference exists: the vendor marks the scripting API as not officially supported or documented, the page explicitly says there is no interactive reference or machine-readable spec, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger files all return 404. The short scripting snippets on the docs page are static examples, not runnable ones inside an explorable reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
